1.title: Federal Judge Orders Texas to Air-Condition Its Prisons
1.summary: The lack of air-conditioning in most of the state’s prisons violates the U.S. Constitution, the judge ruled. He ordered the state to cool all of its lockups by the end of 2029.

2.title: Trump Officials Eject 750,000 From Obamacare Markets, Claiming Fraud
2.summary: Vice President JD Vance said the measure would save the government $2.2 billion.

3.title: Trump tells UN he has 'big decision' on whether to 'annihilate' Iran or make peace deal
3.summary: His tone contrasted with remarks earlier from UN Secretary General António Guterres, who warned global divisions were deepening.

4.title: U.N. Live Updates: As Trump Threatens Iran, Other Leaders Warn of Deep Divisions
4.summary: President Trump said he must decide whether to make a deal or “annihilate” Iran, in a gathering where world leaders typically focus on declarations of global harmony.

5.title: Trump threatens to 'annihilate' Iran in UN speech as officials meet on sidelines
5.summary: In his speech, the US president pondered whether a peace deal would be agreed or whether he would have to take extreme action against Iran.

6.title: US to build two military bases in Greenland under new deal with Denmark
6.summary: The defence deal signed at the UN General Assembly also re-affirms Denmark's sovereignty over its semi-autonomous Arctic territory.
